description: We are a team of enthusiastic students passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. Through this challenge, we aim to uncover and share the stories behind NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. We are excited to combine our technical skills, research, and creativity to build an engaging and informative solution for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
Echoes Beyond Earth is an interactive website developed to showcase the history and achievements of space exploration missions to the Moon and Mars. The website presents important missions, including lunar landers, rovers, and Mars exploration vehicles, through informative descriptions, images, individual mission story pages, and a chronological timeline.

The project addresses the challenge of making space exploration information easy to access, understand, and explore by organizing mission details in a user-friendly and visually engaging format. Users can discover different missions, learn about their objectives and achievements, and understand the progress of planetary exploration over time.

This project is important because it promotes awareness of space science, highlights major technological achievements, and inspires curiosity and interest in future space exploration.
details: Echoes Beyond Earth is an interactive website developed to explore and showcase the history, achievements, and technological advancements of space exploration missions to the Moon and Mars. The website provides information about important space missions, including lunar landers, rovers, and Mars landers, through detailed descriptions, images, individual mission story pages, and a chronological timeline. Users can explore different missions, learn about their objectives, landing locations, launch years, and scientific contributions, making space exploration information easier to understand and access. The project aims to address the challenge of presenting complex space science information in an organized, engaging, and user-friendly manner. It benefits students, space enthusiasts, and the general public by providing an accessible platform to learn about planetary exploration and major scientific discoveries. The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with JSON files to store and organize mission information. It was deployed using Vercel, and GitHub was used for version control and collaborative development. The creative aspect of the project lies in combining visual storytelling, interactive exploration, mission-based information, and a chronological timeline to create an engaging learning experience. During development, the team considered factors such as information accuracy, reliable sources, user-friendly navigation, visual presentation, responsive design, accessibility, and proper organization of mission data. The intended impact is to increase awareness of space exploration, encourage interest in astronomy and space science, and inspire curiosity about humanity's continuing efforts to explore beyond Earth.
